line => new MarketAuthEntry(
                MapType(line.DataElementType),
                line.Code,
                line.LongName)
v => BuildVariant(v, info.ProductType, classifications, info.Id, allUpstreamEntities)

x => x.Pno12 == request.Pno12 &&
                                 x.ModelYear == request.ModelYear &&
                                 x.LocalEditionCode == request.LocalEditionCode &&
                                 x.Market == request.Market
existing => changes.Any(change => change.Type == existing.Type && change.Code == existing.Code)
v => v is not null && Matches(v, entity)
data => GetPaginatedProductDetails(data, next, take, productType, cancellationToken)
data => GetPaginatedVariantDetails(data, next, take, productType, cancellationToken)

token => DeserializeCursorToken<ProductTypePaginationToken>(token).ProductType != productType
                ? $"Product type mismatch: expected {productType}"
                : null

token => DeserializeCursorToken<ProductTypePaginationToken>(token).ProductType != productType
                ? $"Product type mismatch: expected {productType}"
                : null

token => DeserializeCursorToken<ProductIdPaginationToken>(token).ProductId != productId
                ? $"Product Id mismatch: expected {productId}"
                : null
p => new TransformationProductResult { ProductType = p.ProductType, UpstreamId = p.UpstreamId, VariantId = p.VariantId }

sv => new SpecificationValue(
                    sv.Id,
                    sv.Value,
                    sv.Specification.Id,
                    sv.Specification.Code,
                    sv.Specification.Unit,
                    packageVariant.Id)

sv => new SpecificationValue(
                    sv.Id,
                    sv.Value,
                    sv.Specification.Id,
                    sv.Specification.Code,
                    sv.Specification.Unit,
                    packageVariant.Id)
ex => new ExceptionalError("Failed to parse GlobalDictionaryEntriesUpdatedMessage", ex)

message => message is null
                ? Result.Fail<GlobalDictionaryEntriesUpdatedMessage>("Failed to get GlobalDictionaryEntriesUpdatedMessage")
                : Result.Ok(message)

message => message.Entries.Count == 0
                ? Result.Fail<List<GlobalDictionaryEntryData>>("GlobalDictionaryEntriesUpdatedMessage contained no entries")
                : Result.Ok(message.Entries.ToList())
ex => new ExceptionalError("Failed to parse MarketAuthEntriesUpdatedMessage", ex)

message => message is null
                ? Result.Fail<MarketAuthEntriesUpdatedMessage>("Failed to get MarketAuthEntry")
                : Result.Ok(message)

content => content is null ?
            Result.Fail($"Content deserialization for ProductDetailsResponse was null") :
            Result.Ok(content)
p => new TokenToVariantsMatchingProduct { VariantId = p.VariantId, UpstreamId = p.UpstreamId, ProductType = p.ProductType }
p => new TokenToVariantsProduct { UpstreamId = p.UpstreamId, ProductType = p.ProductType }
e => e.Message is var msg && errorStrings.Any(e => msg.Contains(e))

v => new DetailInfoVariant(
                v.Id.ToString(),
                v.Name,
                v.Metadata.ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty), // Convert object values to string
                GetCode(v.Metadata.ToDictionary()),
                [ .. v.SpecificationValues.ToList().Select(sv => ToSpecificationValue(sv, specificationValues, v.Id.ToString())) ],
                [ .. v.IncludedVariants.Select(i => ToDetailInfoVariant(i, specificationValues)) ]
            )
async variant => await SaveVariantAndBuildResult(mapperResponse, variant, cancellationToken)
